# Scoopy Doo AVL - Dog Poop Removal in Asheville, NC

> Scoopy Doo AVL is a locally owned dog poop removal and pooper scooper service in Asheville, NC. It serves Asheville (including West Asheville and Downtown), Arden, Fletcher, Hendersonville, Black Mountain, Weaverville, Fairview, Candler, Swannanoa, Woodfin, Mills River, Biltmore Forest, and Brevard, NC, with weekly, twice-weekly, every-other-week, and one-time pet waste removal for homes, plus common-area and pet waste station service for HOAs and apartment communities. Quotes and payment are 100% online at scoopyavl.com/quote, every visit includes an on-the-way text and a gate photo, and there are no contracts.

## Key facts
- Business: Scoopy Doo AVL, locally owned, Asheville, NC
- Phone/text: 828-844-8060 | Email: info@scoopyavl.com
- Website and online quote: https://www.scoopyavl.com/quote
- Prices: Weekly service is $20 per visit for one dog, twice-weekly is $18 per visit, every-other-week is $33 per visit, and one-time cleanups start at $85. Extra dogs add a small per-visit fee, and every price is shown instantly online at scoopyavl.com/quote.
- Service area: Asheville (including West Asheville and Downtown), Arden, Fletcher, Hendersonville, Black Mountain, Weaverville, Fairview, Candler, Swannanoa, Woodfin, Mills River, Biltmore Forest, and Brevard, NC
- Every visit: An on-the-way text before the technician arrives; The whole yard walked in a grid pattern so nothing is missed; All waste bagged and hauled off the property, never left in your trash can; The gate closed and a photo of the secured gate texted to you when done.
- Policies: Quote and pay 100% online, no phone tag required; No contracts and no cancellation fees, pause or cancel any time; You do not need to be home.
